description: Electrical consumption of one building located at the Campus of University of Girona. is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Joaquim Massana, Carles Pous (University of Girona). This dataset is a supplement of the the following paper "Identifying services for short-term load forecasting using data driven models in a Smart City platform". Authors: J. Massana, C. Pous et al.Journal: Sustainable Cities and Society, Vol. 28, Jan. 2017, pp. 108-117. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CDLA-PERMISSIVE-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository. A related Girona deposit provides PI and PII workbooks enriched with outdoor temperature, calendar/day profiles and artificial occupancy indicators for 2011–2014. The same five-author team links those files to an occupancy-based load-forecasting paper. They cover an overlapping building programme, and identical consumption values are not verified. Treat them as an enriched subset or companion input, not an independent measurement campaign.
